mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_items (user_id, menu_item_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{menuItemId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS id, c.menu_item_id AS menu_item_id, m.name AS item_name, m.price AS unit_price, c.quantity AS quantity, s.id AS stall_id, s.name AS stall_name, s.discount_percent AS stall_discount_percent FROM cart_items c JOIN menu_items m ON c.menu_item_id = m.id JOIN stalls s ON m.stall_id = s.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id
